# Entertainment Weekly

> > Entertainment Weekly is the definitive source for entertainment news, celebrity interviews, TV and film coverage, and pop culture analysis.

EW.com covers breaking entertainment news, in-depth features on movies and television, celebrity profiles, streaming recommendations, and behind-the-scenes insights from Hollywood's biggest stars and productions. The site features exclusive interviews, award show coverage, and cultural commentary on the entertainment industry.

## Key Topics

- Celebrity News
- Movie & Film Coverage
- Television & Streaming
- Award Shows (Actor Awards, Academy Awards)
- Netflix Streaming Content
- Behind-the-Scenes Features
- Celebrity Memoirs
- Social Media & Pop Culture
- HBO Max Programming
- Warner Bros. Pictures
- RuPaul's Drag Race
- The Studio
- Sinners (Michael B. Jordan)
- Celebrity Tributes & Remembrances
- Entertainment Industry News
